commands.name: ApplyAcceptedRfcSourceProjection
commands.visibility: internal cross-packet command invoked by LLD-04 accepted reconciliation; not a raw workbook route
input: accepted field delta set with immutable source_evidence_ids
status vocabulary classification/authority when Status changes
review context when terminal reversal/high-risk correction applies
steps: inside shared UoW load exact RFC/current projection/hierarchy and resolve idempotent replay before mutation
validate accepted evidence identities and LLD-04 precedence through RfcSourceEvidenceProvider
determine the exact current-field changes and any terminal-epoch/cascade effect
insert command receipt before any projection/cascade row that references command_id; rollback removes the receipt on any later failure
apply only accepted usable current field changes
for transition into terminal allocate terminal_epoch_id and atomically capture/insert exact pending cascade proposal and immutable RFC/WFM membership
for terminal reversal require exact fresh high-risk review, clear current terminal epoch and supersede any still-pending proposal for that epoch without undoing executed history
append minimal audit/result references and commit with the owning reconciliation transaction
rules: source acceptance never overwrites RFC hierarchy, SR links, Device Reference links, Working Notes, archive state or canonical Customer without their governed commands
terminal evidence acceptance never executes Task/Objective/Communication cascade consequences
unchanged current accepted fields produce semantic NO_CHANGE at field level and no duplicate current-history authority

commands.name: RefreshRfcTerminalCascadeProposal
steps: inside UoW prove proposal is pending and trigger RFC is still in the same terminal epoch/evidence
capture current exact RFC/WFM scope and compute replacement fingerprint
if scope is materially unchanged return semantic NO_CHANGE
insert receipt, supersede old proposal with immutable provenance, insert replacement pending proposal/member rows, audit refresh, commit
rules: executed or already superseded proposal cannot be refreshed

commands.name: ExecuteRfcTerminalCascade
steps: verify deliberate action proof against authenticated session/proposal revision/fingerprint
inside one UoW resolve idempotent replay, revalidate same current terminal epoch/evidence and exact RFC/WFM membership
if any scope/member/revision differs return RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE with no mutation
insert command receipt before participant/domain rows can reference command_id; rollback removes it on participant failure
invoke LLD-05 Task/Objective participant and LLD-09 Communication participant using this same UoW
if any participant fails or is indeterminate roll back everything and keep proposal pending
transition proposal to executed, append minimal audit/result references, commit atomically
rules: safe auto-accept cannot call this command
SRs and unrelated Local Tasks are never cascade targets
provider WFM evidence is never rewritten

commands.name: ArchiveRfc
steps: inside UoW recalculate exact requested scope and require reviewed fingerprint/revisions still match
identify active members that will change and already-archived members that remain untouched
if no member changes return semantic NO_CHANGE
allocate archive operation ID and insert receipt/operation row
transition only active reviewed members to archived and increment revisions
insert immutable operation membership plus archived event for each changed member using resulting RFC revision as event order
audit exact changes and commit
rules: archive affects RFC local presentation only
pre-existing archived members are never claimed by this operation
branch archive requires explicit exact preview

commands.name: RestoreRfcArchiveOperation
steps: inside UoW load immutable operation membership
for each member read current archive state and latest-by-resulting-revision archive event
select only members still archived by this exact origin operation; later restored/rearchived members are excluded
if no member remains eligible return semantic NO_CHANGE
insert receipt, transition eligible members to active/increment revision, append restored events with resulting revisions referencing origin operation, audit per-member outcomes, commit
rules: restore never activates a member this operation did not itself archive
source lifecycle/status and downstream domains remain untouched

commands.name: HardDeleteRfc
steps: inside UoW load exact RFC/revision and recompute every hard-delete eligibility guard/provider token from current state
require the recomputed eligible fingerprint matches the reviewed preview and no blocker/INDETERMINATE exists
insert command receipt

append the minimal RFC hard-delete audit event while the target identity/business number are still available; this current command evidence is excluded from the pre-command untouched-history predicate
delete the RFC row only; no generic cascade is used and any unexpected dependent FK causes rollback
commit
rules: only a provably untouched manual draft is eligible
accepted source/provisional adoption, hierarchy/SR/Device/Note/WFM/Task/Objective/Communication/Inventory/archive/correction history blocks deletion
creation audit does not by itself make a never-used manual draft undeletable; any post-creation protected activity does
there are no default local child rows silently deleted to manufacture eligibility
ordinary history-bearing RFCs use archive/terminal/correction flows
